Approve and share

When a walkthrough is Ready for your review, you walk it on your phone, tick one box and press Approve and share once. Nothing is shared before that.

  1. Tap the Ready for your review notification, or open the listing and tap Review walkthrough.
  2. Walk through every room on your phone. If the review lists areas under Worth a look before you share, walk to each one: see worth a look. They are advice and never stop you approving.
  3. Tick the one box: “I have the right to share this walkthrough.”
  4. Press Approve and share. Anyone with the link can open it and forward it. It stays online while your plan is active.
  5. The listing now reads Live. Share it: see share your walkthrough.

A walk-through checklist (optional)

  • Every room you meant to include is there, with its floor and walls.
  • Walls, furniture and edges stay straight as you turn.
  • You can walk from room to room without passing through a wall.
  • No people, photos, documents or screens show that should not be seen.
  • It opens and moves smoothly on your phone.

The checklist is a suggestion; nothing records it. The box you tick is your confirmation that you may share this walkthrough, which needs permission to capture the home and to publish it (see privacy and permission).

If it doesn’t work

The button stays off until that one box is ticked.

If something needs fixing, don’t approve. A permitted whole recapture must include every original room. To replace it, choose Replace this walkthrough in your Veylet account, then confirm Use this capture as replacement. Wait for Replacement saved before approving. It replaces this walkthrough on the same link and uses no extra walkthrough. Review and approve the replacement before the link updates.

Approved. Sharing waits for a reason: the card names the one fix, such as someone with sharing permission. Your approval is kept.

You can also review in your Veylet account on a computer, with the same one box.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to yoda@yodalai.xyz and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
